### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, after one prior write. Visible grounds:

- `find_utility_accounts` → `status: final_billed`, `service_end_date 2026-09-22`, `utility_balance −750.00`; `final_credit_refund_request`: "A credit balance left on a final-billed Utility Pass-Through Service account is refunded by check to the former resident on the former resident's request." → eligible.
- Prerequisite (state form, same document): "A credit balance is not refunded until a late fee stands on the account for every statement whose unpaid amount at the end of its grace period reached the late-fee minimum." Records: statement 2026-09 (dated 2026-09-01, due 2026-09-21) = usage 86.26 + fixed 9.85/38.50/21.75 + admin 3.25 = 159.61. Grace (5 days, `late_fee_grace_and_courtesy_waivers` §1) ends 2026-09-26. Payments on or before 2026-09-26 applied oldest first: every earlier payment (`office_personal_check` on the 12th of each month) exactly cleared the previous statement; the 2026-08-12 payment 170.29 cleared statement 2026-08; nothing else received until the 750.00 cashier's check on 2026-09-29. → unpaid at end of grace 159.61 ≥ late-fee minimum 10.00; no `utility_late_fee` entry on the ledger. Statement 2026-10 (due 2026-10-21) has not reached the end of its grace period. → the prerequisite is not met at the opening, for exactly one statement (2026-09).
- Not a wait/refuse: the late fee may be posted now (from 2026-09-27; `late_fee_amount_rule`: "posted in the month after the statement month"); the courtesy waiver is unavailable ("a waiver is granted only while the account is active").

**(a) Late fee on statement 2026-09** — `late_fee_amount_rule`: figured on "the statement dated one whole month before the handling date" (2026-09-01 → 2026-10-09 = 1 whole month); charged because unpaid at end of grace 159.61 ≥ 10.00; baseline = schedule's late fee amount (Submetered Water Schedule 10.00), rounded once.

|---|---|---|

| `late_fee_closed_lease_share` | lease `status: closed`; `notice_to_vacate` `accepted` | 75 percent |
| `late_fee_history_share` | no utility late fee posted in the last 12 months | 50 percent |

| `late_fee_tenure_share` | `service_start_date 2009-05-15` (208 whole months) | 80 percent |

Working: 9.58 × 0.75 × 0.50 × 1.10 × 0.80 = 3.1614 → **3.16** (`billing_period` 2026-09). Fall-back: 10.00 — definite and different. Balance after posting: −746.84.

**(b) Refund** — `credit_refund_amount`: credit balance less held recent payments, floor 0, cap, round once.

| Factor document | Record words | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| `personal_check_holding_period` | no returned payment; utility late fee in last 12 months (the fee just posted, 2026-10-09) and lease late fee 2026-06-07 | 10 days → check of 2026-10-02 (7 days) held: −159.61 |
| `portal_bank_payment_holding_period` | no autopay draft on the lease ledger in 6 months; one bank-account payment on the utility account in 12 months | 4 days → portal payment of 2026-10-06 (3 days) held: −118.33 |
| `refund_true_up_reserve_rate` | latest water read 2026-09-22 estimated, 17 days old | 50 percent of the reserve base |
| `refund_true_up_reserve_base` | two estimated reads in the last 2 months (2026-09-22: 0, 2026-08-22: 1 whole month) | sum of water usage charges dated in the last 2 months: 86.26 (2026-09-01) + 44.98 (2026-10-01) = 131.24 → reserve 65.62, "deducted from the credit balance as well" |
| `refund_limit_by_tenure` | 208 whole months of service | ≥ 180 → no more than 1000.00 at one time |

Working: 746.84 − 159.61 − 118.33 − 65.62 = 403.28 (< 1000.00) → **403.28**; 343.56 stays on the account.
Fall-back (computation document alone, balance after the late fee): check 7 days ≥ 5 not held; portal payment 3 days ≥ 2 not held; no reserve; cap 250.00 → 250.00 — definite and different.
Note on the cap: both the baseline ("no more than 250.00 dollars is refunded at one time") and the tenure document ("no more than 1000.00 dollars is refunded at one time") are phrased as caps; read conjunctively the tenure provision would never bind. Its worked figures ("exactly 15 years | 180 | 820.00 | 820.00"; "14 years 11 months | 179 | 820.00 | 600.00, with 220.00 staying on the account") show refunds above 250.00, which settles that the tenure limit takes the place of the 250.00 figure for these accounts.
Ordering note: the 10-day personal-check tier rests on a utility late fee standing on the account; at the opening there is none (tier would be "no longer period", 5 days, not held). Because the refund may be worked out only after the late fee stands, the tier is read on the post-fee records.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 refund of the final credit (root, customer's own write) ← P2 late fee on statement 2026-09. Order: P2 → P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (`final_credit_refund_request`, "Late fees and the credit balance"): "A credit balance is not refunded until a late fee stands on the account for every statement whose unpaid amount at the end of its grace period reached the late-fee minimum." Records: statement 2026-09 unpaid 159.61 at the end of grace, no late fee entry. Write found by searching "late fee": `utility_late_fee_posting` ("A utility late fee is the charge a ... account carries for one statement left unpaid past its grace period ... charges it against the statement month it belongs to"), with its own tool; amount from `late_fee_amount_rule` and its factor documents. The refund document names no late-fee tool or document.

- No hop pre-solved.

### Counter-proofs

- "Do only what was asked" (refund now): excluded by the prerequisite sentence and its restatement "while any statement whose unpaid amount ... reached the late-fee minimum has no late fee standing on the account, no part of the credit balance is refunded".
- Courtesy-waiving the fee instead: excluded — "a waiver is granted only while the account is active" (account final billed).
- Statement choice: 2026-10 (0 whole months) excluded by the "one whole month" table; 2026-08 paid in full before its due date.
- Retired former fee clause (`late_fee_grace_and_courtesy_waivers` §2) vs the in-force `late_fee_amount_rule`: the in-force document itself restates minimum / once per statement / no fee on a fee / schedule amount, so the result is the same; recorded for the scan.
- Cap 250.00 vs 1000.00: see the note in 4(b).
- Mailing address: `final_credit_refund_request` "To the mailing address on the resident's profile"; profile already shows the new address; no profile change is needed.
